tracks.title: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear
tracks.file: 03 - It Came Upon a Midnight Clear [it-came-upon-a-midnight-].mp3
tracks.uploader: Singing Sergeants, United States Air Force Band
tracks.lyrics:
[00:00.00]It came upon the midnight clear,
[00:06.76]That glorious song of old,
[00:13.74]From angels bending near the earth
[00:19.80]To touch their harps of gold:
[00:27.54]"Peace on the earth, good will to men,
[00:35.00]From heaven's all-gracious King."
[00:43.08]The world in solemn stillness lay
[00:51.66]To hear the angels sing.

[00:59.45]Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
[01:07.86]The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
[01:18.10]The stars in the sky looked down where He lay,
[01:28.06]The little Lord Jesus, asleep on the hay.

tracks.title: O Little Town of Bethlehem
tracks.uploader: Singing Sergeants, United States Air Force Band
tracks.lyrics:
[00:00.00]O little town of Bethlehem,
[00:06.16]How still we see thee lie!
[00:13.44]Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
[00:19.94]The silent stars go by;
[00:27.94]Yet in thy dark streets shineth
[00:35.74]The everlasting Light;
[00:42.80]The hopes and fears of all the years
[00:52.72]Are met in thee tonight.

[00:15.36]And heaven and nature sing,
[00:17.20]And heaven, and heaven, and nature sing.

[00:22.24]Joy to the Earth! The Savior reigns!
[00:26.20]Let men their songs employ;

[00:34.20]Repeat the sounding joy,
[00:35.94]Repeat the sounding joy,
[00:38.60]Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.

[00:42.44]He rules the world with truth and grace,
[00:46.38]And makes the nations prove
[00:49.96]The glories of His righteousness,
[00:55.56]And wonders of His love,
[00:57.26]And wonders of His love,
[00:59.20]And wonders, wonders, of His love.

tracks.title: Good King Wenceslas
tracks.uploader: Chorus of the U.S. Army Band "Pershing's Own"
tracks.lyrics:
[00:00.80]Good King Wenceslas look'd out, On the Feast of Stephen;
[00:05.66]When the snow lay round about, Deep, and crisp, and even:
[00:10.28]Brightly shone the moon that night, Though the frost was cruel,
[00:15.10]When a poor man came in sight, Gath'ring winter fuel.

[00:22.50]"Bring me flesh, and bring me wine, Bring me pine logs hither:
[00:27.64]"Thou and I will see him dine, When we bear them thither."
[00:32.36]Page and monarch forth they went, Forth they went together:
[00:37.06]Through the rude wind's wild lament And the bitter weather.

[00:44.70]In his master's steps he trod, Where the snow lay dinted;
[00:49.28]Heat was in the very sod Which the Saint had printed.
[00:53.80]Therefore, Christian men, be sure, Wealth or rank possessing,
[00:59.10]Ye who now will bless the poor, Shall yourselves find blessing.
